{
  "sprint_goal": "Deliver a unified payment admin workspace enabling treasury ops to search batches, manage refunds, approve payouts, and generate audit reports with full PaymentCore and Payment Rail integration.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Implement merchant and payment batch search UI",
      "description": "Create search and filter components in Next.js using shadcn/ui for merchants and payment batches with real-time pagination, ensuring results load under 1.5 seconds from PaymentCore GraphQL.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Integrate PaymentCore GraphQL for search queries",
      "description": "Develop GraphQL client in TypeScript to fetch merchant, batch, and settlement data via API Gateway with mTLS and OAuth2 client credentials flow.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Build settlement timeline and transaction drill-down view",
      "description": "Design and implement interactive timeline visualization that retrieves ledger and event data from PaymentCore and Payment Rail APIs for selected payment batches.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Develop refund and adjustment initiation flow",
      "description": "Implement refund/adjustment trigger through Payment Actions service using Payment Rail REST APIs, ensuring audit logs are emitted to Kafka and S3 archives.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 7.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Implement payout approval workflow with automated allocation rules",
      "description": "Add manager approval UI with role-based gating and backend logic applying automated allocation rules and audit logging via Payment Actions service.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Configure RBAC enforcement for OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles",
      "description": "Set permissions and feature flags in frontend and backend ensuring restricted access to approval and refund actions per defined roles.",
      "category": "Security",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-005"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Implement anomaly alert display in dashboard",
      "description": "Consume Payment Rail event streams and render anomaly alerts with merchant and batch context in workspace dashboard.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-008",
      "title": "Develop audit-ready report export and S3 archival",
      "description": "Create export functionality for auditors to download CSV/JSON reports; implement S3 archival with proper IAM policies and audit logging.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 5.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-006"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-009",
      "title": "Add integration test suite for payment actions and approval flows",
      "description": "Write automated tests in Jest to validate refund, adjustment, and approval logic with Kafka audit message verification.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 5.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004", "T-005"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-010",
      "title": "Prepare deployment scripts and private VNet configuration",
      "description": "Configure CI/CD pipeline for deploying Next.js and backend services inside private VNet ensuring mTLS setup and no external calls.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-008", "T-009"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-001",
      "description": "API latency from PaymentCore or Payment Rail could exceed performance SLAs",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Implement request caching and optimize GraphQL query fields; monitor latency metrics and fallback to async updates if necessary."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-002",
      "description": "RBAC misconfiguration could expose sensitive payout approval screens",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Verify RBAC permissions in staging with test accounts and conduct role-specific UAT review before production release."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-003",
      "description": "Audit log emission to Kafka/S3 may fail under high load",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Implement retry logic and error monitoring for Kafka producers and S3 uploads during heavy transaction peaks."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-004",
      "description": "Integration complexity between PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST may delay backend delivery",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Stub endpoints early for UI development and conduct mock integration testing in parallel to reduce dependency delays."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-005",
      "description": "Analyst dashboard performance may degrade under multi-region concurrency",
      "severity": "Low",
      "mitigation": "Enable client-side pagination and limit result sets; perform load testing simulating 60 concurrent users."
    }
  ],
  "definition_of_done": [
    "All user stories pass acceptance criteria with verified audit logs in Kafka and S3",
    "RBAC validated for OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles",
    "UI responsive and search/performance metrics meet SLA (<1.5s search, <4s payout)",
    "Integration tests for refund and payout approval workflows succeed",
    "Code reviewed and merged to main with CI/CD deployment inside private VNet",
    "Sprint demo completed and documentation updated for Treasury Operations onboarding"
  ],
  "total_estimated_hours": 57.0
}

{
  "test_strategy": "Adopt a layered testing approach combining unit testing (Jest) for service logic and middleware, integration testing for PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST APIs using msw or nock stubs, and full E2E tests using Playwright against the Next.js UI to validate workflows (search, drilldown, refund, approvals, alerts, export). Security tests cover RBAC enforcement and mTLS/OAuth2 authentication. Performance/load tests ensure SLA (<1.5s search, <4s payouts). Kafka and S3 audit verifications included in integration scope.",
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Merchant and batch search responsiveness",
      "description": "Verify that merchants and payment batches can be searched across ACH, RTP, and WIRE rails within defined performance SLA.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["OpsAnalyst user logged in with proper RBAC role", "System connected to PaymentCore GraphQL replica"],
      "steps": ["Navigate to Search UI", "Enter merchantName and select paymentRail", "Submit search request", "Measure response time"],
      "expected_result": "Search results render correctly with total count and pagination within 1.5 seconds.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "Settlement timeline drilldown view",
      "description": "Validate that selecting a payment batch retrieves timeline and transaction details from PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Payment batch exists in PaymentCore", "OpsAnalyst logged in"],
      "steps": ["Select batchId from search results", "Click View Timeline", "Inspect response from /api/batches/:batchId/timeline"],
      "expected_result": "Timeline displays chronological events with timestamps and statuses returned under 1.5s latency.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "Refund initiation for eligible payment",
      "description": "Check refund trigger via Payment Actions and confirm audit logs emission to Kafka and S3.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["PaymentRail REST mock available", "Eligible paymentId present", "OpsAnalyst logged in"],
      "steps": ["Call POST /api/payments/:paymentId/refund with reason and amount", "Monitor Kafka topic audit.payments", "Verify S3 object created"],
      "expected_result": "API returns refundId with success status, Kafka receives audit event, and S3 archive file exists.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Refund initiation negative - unauthorized role",
      "description": "Ensure RBAC restriction blocks refund for Auditor role.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["Auditor logged in", "Valid paymentId available"],
      "steps": ["Call POST /api/payments/:paymentId/refund with Auditor role"],
      "expected_result": "HTTP 403 returned, no audit event emitted.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "Approve payout batch with automated allocation",
      "description": "Validate payout approval functionality and audit logging for Manager role.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Manager logged in", "Pending payout batch available"],
      "steps": ["Call POST /api/payouts/:batchId/approve with managerId and allocationPolicy", "Check response for approvalId", "Verify Kafka and S3 logs"],
      "expected_result": "Approval recorded successfully, allocation applied, audit message emitted to Kafka and archived in S3.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Approve payout negative - OpsAnalyst role",
      "description": "Ensure non-manager users cannot perform approval.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["OpsAnalyst logged in", "Payout batch available"],
      "steps": ["POST /api/payouts/:batchId/approve as OpsAnalyst"],
      "expected_result": "Access denied with HTTP 403; no approval or audit log created.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "Display anomaly alerts in dashboard",
      "description": "Confirm that Payment Rail event stream anomalies appear in the dashboard with merchant and batch details.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Payment Rail event stream contains anomalies"],
      "steps": ["Open workspace dashboard", "Trigger refresh", "Observe alert widget contents"],
      "expected_result": "Alerts displayed correctly with message, severity, and timestamp information.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-008",
      "title": "Export audit-ready payment report",
      "description": "Verify auditor can export CSV/JSON report to S3 and receive valid download URL.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Auditor logged in", "S3 integration configured"],
      "steps": ["Call GET /api/reports/export with date range and format", "Inspect response for downloadUrl and archivedTo", "Check S3 bucket for file presence"],
      "expected_result": "Report generated and archived with proper IAM policy, audit event logged.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-009",
      "title": "Search edge case - non-existent merchant",
      "description": "Validate that empty result returned gracefully when merchantName does not exist.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["PaymentCore search endpoint mock configured"],
      "steps": ["POST /api/search with merchantName='UnknownMerchant'"],
      "expected_result": "Empty results array, no errors, response time <1.5s.",
      "priority": "Low"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-010",
      "title": "Performance test - payout round-trip time",
      "description": "Measure payout initiation and approval round-trip latency requirement (<4s).",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["Manager user authenticated", "Payout batch ready for approval"],
      "steps": ["Start timer", "Execute approval API", "Record response time"],
      "expected_result": "Total time from request to response <4s with successful status.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-011",
      "title": "Audit event integrity validation",
      "description": "Ensure audit payload matches schema and timestamp correctness.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Kafka and S3 event available after refund or approval action"],
      "steps": ["Fetch audit message from Kafka", "Compare with S3 archived file"],
      "expected_result": "Audit event JSON consistent across Kafka and S3 with valid timestamp and action fields.",
      "priority": "High"
    }
  ],
  "test_data_requirements": [
    "Merchant records across ACH, RTP, WIRE rails",
    "Sample payment batches with transactions in various statuses (Pending, Approved, Refunded)",
    "Mock PaymentCore GraphQL responses for search and timeline",
    "Mock Payment Rail REST endpoints for refund and approval actions",
    "Kafka test topic setup for audit events",
    "S3 test bucket for archival verification",
    "User accounts mapped to RBAC roles (OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor)"
  ],
  "automation_approach": "Utilize Jest for unit and integration testing with mocks (nock/msw) for API calls, Playwright for E2E UI tests validating behavior and performance. Kafka audit event verification scripted via kafkajs consumer in Jest tests. Include CI/CD integration triggering automated test pipelines on merge. Load tests via k6 or Artillery targeting SLA metrics. Ensure fixtures and test data reset through Docker Compose for isolated environments.",
  "coverage_goals": "Achieve 90% unit test coverage across backend controllers and middleware, 100% verification of all RBAC roles and workflows (search, drilldown, refund, approval, alerts, export). Integration tests to validate API interoperability and audit pipeline end-to-end. E2E test suite ensures functional parity with PO story acceptance criteria and performance SLA adherence across UI and backend."
}

{
  "summary": "The sprint delivers a unified payment administration workspace for Treasury Operations, replacing fragmented spreadsheets with a secure, high-performance platform that integrates PaymentCore and Payment Rail data. Analysts and managers gain controlled access to search merchants and batches, drill into settlements, trigger refunds, approve payouts, and generate audit-ready reports, ensuring compliance and operational efficiency across regions.",
  "scope_overview": "This release includes the production-ready MVP of the payment admin workspace built with Next.js 14 and TypeScript. Core features: merchant/batch search, settlement drill-down, refund initiation, payout approvals with automated allocation, anomaly alerts, and audit report exports. All actions are logged to Kafka and archived in S3 with RBAC enforcement and integration with PaymentCore (GraphQL) and Payment Rail (REST) APIs via secured API Gateway.",
  "key_risks": [
    "API latency from PaymentCore or Payment Rail may breach SLA thresholds (<1.5s for search, <4s for payouts).",
    "RBAC misconfiguration could expose sensitive approval workflows to unauthorized users."
  ],
  "test_readiness": "QA reports strong test coverage across search, refund, approval, and export workflows with E2E and integration tests validating performance and RBAC compliance. Kafka/S3 audit emissions are verified, and all high-priority test cases pass functional and security criteria. System is test-ready for production deployment under defined SLAs.",
  "recommendations": [
    "Monitor live API latency and implement caching to mitigate performance risks during peak transaction volumes.",
    "Conduct UAT with Treasury Ops managers to confirm approval and audit workflows before release sign-off."
  ],
  "next_steps": [
    "Finalize deployment within private VNet, enforcing mTLS and OAuth2 configurations.",
    "Schedule business rollout and training sessions for 60 regional analysts and managers post-production release."
  ]
}
